request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Molten Pikeguard".

Creative brief
Name: Molten Pikeguard
Collection: Ashforge Remnants. Abandoned forge creatures and half-living constructs powered by coals, slag, chains, soot, and unstable furnace heat.
Core concept: A formation soldier that fires narrow piercing lanes and punishes direct approaches.
Body and silhouette: Tall armored construct with a pointed helmet, rectangular shield, and extra-long heated pike.
Signature features: Glowing pike tip, shield furnace slit, and segmented iron skirt.
Palette and materials: Dark iron, dull crimson, molten orange, and ash gray.
Movement personality: Disciplined, slow, and unwavering.
Attack concept: Levels its pike with a visible glow before launching a fast straight bolt, followed by two slower sparks beside the original lane.
Directional details: The shield is always held on the left arm.
Avoid: Roman armor, firearm interpretation, decorative details obscuring the weapon direction.
